clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Derived from current NCCP 00658 version 2. All dose changes require consultant/pharmacy confirmation. Numeric adjustments are not inferred from incomplete context or ambiguous table boundaries.

indications.description: Adjuvant treatment of Grade II glioma administered after radiotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Lomustine 110 mg/m² PO Day 1; procarbazine 60 mg/m² PO Days 8–21; vincristine 1.4 mg/m² IV (max 2 mg) Days 8 and 29; repeat every 56 days for 6 cycles.
treatment.duration_text: Six 56-day cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity.

components.note: One dose on Day 1 only. Capsules 40 mg. Do not take daily or repeat before the prescribed next cycle. Prescription and capsule supply require pharmacy confirmation.
Days 8–21 inclusive. Capsules 50 mg; round prescribed dose to nearest 50 mg. The supportive-care row says Days 8–22, conflicting with the treatment table: do not add Day 22.
50 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 10 minutes. Intravenous use only; follow NCCP neurotoxic-drug safety guidance.
